purpose: A triggering set for the package descriptions. A skill that does not load cannot enforce anything, so this file is checked before and after any description change.
how_to_score: Run each query in a fresh session with the package installed and no other instruction, then record which skill loaded, if any. A query marked should_trigger passes when the named skill loads, or when the hub loads and routes there on the first turn. A query marked should_not_trigger passes when no package skill loads. Score the first skill that loads, not the eventual one: a specialist that loads only after the student repeats themselves in package vocabulary has already failed the undertriggering test.
notes: The hub is the whole install. If it does not fire, nothing else does, so its queries matter most.
Every description's first 57 characters are the part that shows in a truncated catalog listing, so they have to stand alone.
The skill-creator toolkit ships run_loop.py, which scores a description against a query set like this one and iterates. Use it when a harness has that toolkit available, and score by hand otherwise.

queries.query: help me build a case on NKE for my portfolio
queries.why: Plain-chat phrasing with no package vocabulary. The hub has to fire on this.

queries.query: i have to pitch a company to the fund on tuesday, where do i start
queries.why: Task first, no company named yet. Still the hub.

queries.query: can you research Doordash for my equity pitch
queries.why: The straightforward entry phrasing.

queries.query: i need to show how they actually make money
queries.why: A student describing the Business section without naming it.

queries.query: is their market even growing
queries.why: The industry outlook part of the Business section in the student's words.

queries.query: who are they up against and do they have a moat
queries.why: Competition section, phrased as a question.

queries.query: what did they buy last year and why
queries.why: Key Deals without the package's term for it.

queries.query: show me the unit economics and whether the margins are real
queries.why: Financials section, two of its required elements.

queries.query: what should this company be worth
queries.why: Valuation, asked the way an analyst thinks about it.

queries.query: build the discounted cash flow for UBER
queries.why: Direct route to the model.

queries.query: what has the street been saying about them lately
queries.why: Direct route to the market view and news lanes.

queries.query: make the deck look like the fund's decks
queries.why: Direct route to the deck standard.

queries.query: does every number on this slide have a source
queries.why: Direct route to the evidence rules.

queries.query: poke holes in this thesis for me
queries.why: Direct route to the red team.

queries.query: what is a discounted cash flow
queries.why: A definition of a mechanism. The hub answers it directly and runs no loop.

queries.query: what is Apple trading at right now
queries.why: A price quote, which the package refuses on purpose.

queries.query: buy 100 shares of AAPL in my brokerage account
queries.why: Order execution, out of scope.

queries.query: should i put my bonus into my 401k or a Roth
queries.why: Personal financial advice, out of scope.

queries.query: summarize the risk factors in this 10-K for a class assignment
queries.why: A document summary with no pitch behind it. The evidence discipline is not wanted here.

queries.query: screen the S and P 500 for the cheapest price to earnings ratios
queries.why: Screening and stock picking, which the package explicitly is not.
